rationale: Add a dependency-download cache for NuGet packages (actions/cache@v4, ~/.nuget/packages) in each of the six build jobs, placed after setup-dotnet and before the PublishToLocal.ps1 build step. This matches the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE dependency_cache pattern and the measured experiment experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200, which reported 20.4% elapsed-time savings from caching dependency downloads while keeping all install/build/test steps intact. The cache key uses runner.os plus a hash of csproj/lockfile manifests with restore-keys fallback, so dependency changes invalidate the cache and no build output or test coverage is removed. No secrets, permissions, deployment/publishing steps, or new external network destinations are introduced; cache@v4 uses the same GitHub Actions platform communication already present via checkout/setup-dotnet/upload-artifact.
